name: Raphaël Glucksmann - Après le considérant 26 - Am 259
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the screening of foreign investments in the Union and repealing Regulation (EU) 2019/452 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text: (26 a) Opinions issued by the Commission within the framework of the cooperation mechanism should in no case substitute for the sovereign decision of the Member State concerned, nor should they have any binding effect on the outcome of the screening.
